title: Juan Gara de Senisteros to Juan de la Peña, Alcalá 23 Dec 1605 (NA 3.01.14 inv. 2442)

documents.route: Alcalá de Henares -> Juan de la Peña (abroad, unknown)

plaintext.source: No decipherment visible on the scans.

transcription.source: transcription_A.txt (literal, pp. 1-4L, subagent); reading_B.md (read directly with the key, pp. 4R-11)
transcription.notes: Token count = cipher words: 454 on pp. 1-4L (decoded_A.txt) + 993 inside braces in reading_B.md, counted by script; pp. 4R-11 were not transcribed glyph by glyph.

system.summary: Vowel substitution only: a=4, e=8, i/y=3, o=7, u=2, with 5 for s, 6 for b/v and a looped l; all other consonants in clear; word division kept. A few superscript clear glosses over cipher words.
system.notes: Trivial private cipher of a churchman's agent; the decipherment is a reading problem, not a key problem.

prior_solution.where: Not in Haak & Veenendaal (RGP, online OCR searched 23 Oct 2026); no web hit; not on DECODE.

conditions.human_role: Asked to open the target from the Nationaal Archief sweep.

solution.what: Searched the web, DECODE's Dutch-held records and the Haak/Veenendaal Oldenbarnevelt edition OCR for the letter: no prior reading found.
Fetched the 11 Nationaal Archief scans at full resolution through IIIF.
On p01 consonants stand in clear and vowels are digits: 4=a, 8=e, 3=i, 7=o, 2=u (l4s m3sm4s p4l4br4s qu8 s7n p4rt3c2l4r8s).
Subagent transcribed pp. 1-4L literally (transcription_A.txt); a second subagent stopped before writing pp. 4R-11.
Read pp. 4R-11 directly with the vowel key (reading_B.md); pp. 8, 9, 10L, 11 are clear; applied the key by script to pp. 1-4L (decoded_A.txt). Signs 5=s, 6=b/v, looped l resolved from context.
Counted cipher words with unresolved readings: 32/993 (pp. 4R-10) and 14/454 (pp. 1-4L); ~97% read as Spanish sense.

validation.notes: Vowel-only substitution with consonants in clear: the key is five digit values fixed by the word skeletons, so an n-gram overfitting test on the cipher tokens has nothing to discriminate.

outcome.method_basis: The vowel-to-digit substitution was read off the first cipher line of p01 from the clear consonants and word shapes; no outside key or decipherment exists.
outcome.notes: Scattered words unread ([?] in the readings); pp. 4R-11 read without a glyph-level transcription.

texts.label: Juan Gara de Senisteros to Juan de la Peña, Alcalá, 23 Dec 1605 (NA 3.01.14 inv. 2442)
texts.summary: Gara, newly canon and college rector at Alcalá, tells his patron how he forged the patron's signature on a blank sheet to send letters to the Cardinal of Toledo and the abbot and win the electors; reports the provisions of Sigüenza and Pamplona with suspicion of money; asks about the regent's canonry, the Lerma collegiate church and a student's debts; and passes on that the Inquisitor Salcedo's grandmother was a cleric's daughter by the wife of a smith reputed a converso.

reading_review.note: Read as Spanish sentences page by page while deciphering and translated in translation.md; sense is continuous, ~46 words uncertain where the copy is cramped. Not yet checked by a person against the images.
